title: Rewrite a selection with the AI

entries.text: Rewrite a selection with the AI
The AI prompt bar is the same one you use to draft new sections. Select text first, and the AI works on exactly that passage: it rewrites it in place instead of adding text somewhere else.
Select the passage you want to rewrite
Triple-click selects a paragraph; click and drag selects any range.

entries.caption: Triple-click the wordy paragraph to select it

entries.text: Ask the AI to make it shorter
Type what you want into the prompt bar. Short instructions work best: "make this shorter", "translate to German", "turn this into bullet points". Your selection stays put while you type.

entries.caption: Your instruction is ready; the paragraph is still selected.
The wordy paragraph is now one short sentence, in the same place: the paragraphs before and after it are untouched.
